name: strivex
description: StriveX monorepo — NestJS server (staff UI) + station gateway (log UI). Root launcher.

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix gateway install && node scripts/init-env.mjs
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,gateway -c blue,green "cross-env AUTH_DISABLED=1 npm --prefix server run start:dev" "npm --prefix gateway start"
scripts.start:server: cross-env AUTH_DISABLED=1 npm --prefix server run start:dev
